gaps.sentence: I bumped ___ my neighbour at the dentist's.
gaps.explanation: bump into somebody = meet by chance.

gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: We're trying to get rid ___ these old boxes.
gaps.explanation: get rid OF something = remove it.

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
They've set ___ a new charity for homeless dogs.
The fire blew ___ the gas cylinder exploded.
gaps.explanation: blow up = explode, or make something explode.

gaps.sentence: During the tour she pointed ___ the oldest house in town.
gaps.explanation: point out = mention/draw attention to a fact.

gaps.sentence: After twenty years of smoking, he finally managed to give it ___.
gaps.explanation: give up = stop/quit (a habit or attempt).
